meaning_of_existing_references: Selected references exist; their availability does not complete E01
required_before_freeze: Fix physical domains, parameters, initial and boundary conditions for every case
Distinguish cell averages from pointwise analytical values
Fix independent axial, radial and temporal refinement sequences
Define mass normalization and absolute plus relative tolerances per case
Fix norms, time horizons and treatment of absent breakthrough crossings
Define t10 t50 t90 and capacity corrected for dissolved storage
Set case-specific convergence and stability acceptance thresholds with justification
Record all failures and computational budgets including retries
Fix environment, seeds when applicable, scripts and configuration hashes
Version and hash a reviewed E01 subprotocol; document later amendments
